name: @filter-enginez/examples-vanilla
description: Filter EngineZ — framework-less demo app (Vite + plain TypeScript, hand-written DOM). Renders the books demo twice: once over @filter-enginez/reactive-signals (fine-grained signals) and once over the bare @filter-enginez/core engine (coarse subscribe), proving the engine needs neither a framework NOR a reactive-surface adapter. Also renders the fourteen-section real-estate panel — location hierarchy, geo-radius map, six sliders — and the wine panel over a Comlink worker and over HTTP, all on the same hand-built DOM. Browser-only.
